name: threejs-orchard
description: A new 3D Three.js game through make-game, unattended end to end: a gather-carry-deliver loop with moving hazards and a timer, judged on the Studio gates, the bots winning it in the headless browser, and a packaged web build.

input.brief: A 3D third-person game in Three.js: a hedgehog in a hilly orchard at dusk picks up fallen apples and carries them back to a basket by the farmhouse. It can carry at most 3 apples at a time. Hay carts roll along the orchard paths; a cart that hits the hedgehog knocks the apples it carries out onto the grass. Deliver 10 apples before night falls (3 minutes) to win; when night falls first, the game is lost. The camera follows the hedgehog; the HUD shows apples carried, apples delivered and the time left.
